title: ReadList
description: A read of one resource, GET /v1/{resource} (docs/design/m0/08 "Reads"): the records the caller's read scope covers, each authorized against its domain and authoritative project in the same snapshot as the caller's scope, and each carrying only its resource's allow-listed fields. found when any record is returned, else empty.

items.description: One record, its fields the resource's allow-list; one schema per resource.
